cat > /tmp/lotprobe.sh <<'EOF'
set -u
BIN=/data/tk0328/b4/alpha-new; O=/data/tk0328/lotprobe; DAY=2026-05-05
SS=/data/tk0319/e-may/root; FS=/data/tk046/may/home/alpha/epochs/e-may/root
rm -rf $O; mkdir -p $O
for SYM in SUIUSDT LTCUSDT BNBUSDT AAVEUSDT; do
 for pair in "$SS:s" "$FS:f"; do
  src=${pair%%:*}; dst=$O/$SYM/${pair##*:}; mkdir -p $dst
  for f in $src/$SYM-$DAY.binlog $src/verify-$SYM.status $src/instruments.csv $src/session.json; do [ -e $f ] && ln -s $f $dst/; done
 done
 mkdir -p $O/$SYM/t $O/$SYM/p
 $BIN lob touches --root $O/$SYM/s --symbol $SYM --h3-mode notional --h3-usd 10000 --out $O/$SYM/t/touches-$SYM.csv >/dev/null 2>&1
 $BIN lob touches-project --in $O/$SYM/t/touches-$SYM.csv --out $O/$SYM/p/touches-$SYM.csv --spot $O/$SYM/s/$SYM-$DAY.binlog --fut $O/$SYM/f/$SYM-$DAY.binlog > $O/$SYM/report.txt 2>&1
 echo "== $SYM"; head -c 400 $O/$SYM/report.txt
done
python3 - <<'PY'
import csv,glob
for SYM in "SUIUSDT LTCUSDT BNBUSDT AAVEUSDT".split():
    O=f"/data/tk0328/lotprobe/{SYM}"
    def rd(p):
        return list(csv.DictReader(l for l in open(p) if not l.startswith('#')))
    t=rd(f"{O}/t/touches-{SYM}.csv"); p=rd(f"{O}/p/touches-{SYM}.csv")
    cols=['size_at_touch','traded_1s','frontrun_lots','flow_1h_lots']
    print(SYM,'rows',len(t),len(p),'cols_p',[c for c in p[0] if 'step' in c or 'lot' in c][:6] if p else None)
    for c in cols:
        if c in t[0]:
            a=sum(float(r[c] or 0) for r in t); b=sum(float(r[c] or 0) for r in p[:len(t)])
            z=sum(1 for r in t if float(r[c] or 0)>0); zp=sum(1 for r in p if float(r[c] or 0)>0)
            print('  ',c,'sum_spot',a,'sum_proj',b,'nonzero',z,zp)
PY
EOF
scp -q /tmp/lotprobe.sh calc:/data/tk0328/lotprobe.sh && ssh -o BatchMode=yes calc 'systemd-run --wait --collect -p Nice=10 -p CPUQuota=100% --unit tk332-lotprobe bash /data/tk0328/lotprobe.sh 2>&1 | tail -40; journalctl -u tk332-lotprobe --no-pager 2>/dev/null | tail -45 | cut -c1-250'
